high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sannamarin." The post was made 9 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The username is accompanied by a verified badge, indicating that the account is likely official or has been verified by Instagram. The photo itself shows a piece of graffiti art painted on a concrete block. The graffiti features a stylized face with large, round eyes and a wide, toothy grin. The colors used in the graffiti are primarily shades of blue and white, with some red accents.
